property.name: Walk Hotel
property.description: Boutique alpine lifestyle hotel featuring 42 luxury rooms and suites, a dedicated wellness spa, and an artisanal restaurant. Amenities: Alpine Wellness Spa, Farm-to-Table Restaurant, High-Speed WiFi, Heated Ski & Boot Storage, Complimentary Mountain Shuttles, EV Charging Stations.

rooms.name: Classic Queen Room
rooms.description: Comfortable alpine-inspired room with queen bed, ensuite rain shower, and forest views. (12 of this type at the property.)

rooms.name: Deluxe King Room
rooms.description: Spacious king room featuring a private balcony with panoramic mountain views and seating area. (14 of this type at the property.)

rooms.name: Alpine Double Room
rooms.description: Cozy twin/double room crafted with reclaimed larch wood and modern minimalist decor. (8 of this type at the property.)

rooms.name: Panorama Studio
rooms.description: Open-plan studio with floor-to-ceiling glass, kitchenette, king bed, and convertible sofa. (6 of this type at the property.)

rooms.name: Penthouse Suite
rooms.description: Top-floor dual-room suite with private sauna, open fireplace, wraparound terrace, and dedicated butler call service. (2 of this type at the property.)

faqs.question: What are the reception and check-in hours?
faqs.answer: Standard check-in starts at 15:00, and check-out is by 11:00. The reception desk is staffed 24/7. Express digital arrival and keyless entry are enabled via ARIAN.

faqs.question: What are the hours and booking rules for the Alpine Spa?
faqs.answer: The Alpine Spa is open daily from 10:00 to 15:00. Signature 60-minute alpine massages are priced at EUR 150. Advance reservation is mandatory to manage therapist coverage. Treatments must be cleared for medical contraindications during intake.

faqs.question: What are the restaurant opening hours and reservation policies?
faqs.answer: Dinner service runs daily from 18:30 to 21:30 across 12 indoor tables. Reservations are strongly recommended and can be confirmed instantly by voice. Special dietary requirements and allergen notices must be submitted prior to seating.

faqs.question: Is parking available on site?
faqs.answer: Underground secure parking is available for hotel guests at EUR 25 per night. Four 22kW EV chargers are available on a first-come basis.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed at the property?
faqs.answer: Dogs are welcome in designated Classic Queen and Alpine Double rooms with prior notification. A cleaning fee of EUR 35 per stay applies. Dogs must remain leashed in public areas and are not permitted inside the Alpine Spa.

policies.name: check_in_check_out
policies.body: Standard arrival: 15:00. Standard departure: 11:00. Late check-out until 14:00 is subject to availability and a EUR 50 surcharge. Unannounced arrivals after 22:00 trigger late-arrival automated concierge routing.

policies.name: cancellation
policies.body: Flexible bookings may be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours prior to the 15:00 check-in window. Cancellations within 48 hours or no-shows incur a 100% charge for the first night.

policies.name: spa_wellness
policies.body: Spa appointments must be cancelled at least 4 hours in advance to avoid a 50% cancellation fee. Guests must disclose skin treatments, active medications (e.g., retinol), or pregnancy during intake.

policies.name: smoking_damage
policies.body: Walk Hotel is a 100% non-smoking property across all indoor areas and balconies. Violation incurs an immediate EUR 250 deep-cleaning fee plus room downtime charges.
